name: Minato (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Minato ward emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Minato, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 July 1949.

features.role: Minato ward emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character of curved strokes
